From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Image 4

Lionel Messi, the current record-holder, at the 2022 FIFA World Cup.

This list of most-liked Instagram posts contains the top 20 posts by number of likes on the photo and video-sharing social networking service Instagram.

The most-liked post as of July 2026( is of the Argentine footballerLionel Messi and his teammates celebrating the 2022 FIFA World Cup win at Lusail Stadium in Lusail, Qatar, which has been liked by over 74 million different accounts. Uploaded on December 18, 2022, the post shows Messi lifting his first World Cup Trophy after Argentina's win over France in the final. It is one of the most liked posts of all time across all social media platforms.(

## History

[edit]

On January 4, 2019, the account @world_record_egg posted a photo of an egg with the specific purpose of surpassing the then most-liked Instagram post, a picture of Kylie Jenner's daughter with 18.6 million likes.( The photo of the egg was originally taken by Serghei Platanov, who then posted it to Shutterstock on June 23, 2015, with the title "eggs isolated on white background."( The creator of the @world_record_egg account was Chris Godfrey, an advertising creative, and his friends CJ Brown and Alissa Khan-Whelan.(On January 14, 2019, the egg post became the most-liked post on Instagram, to which the egg's account owner wrote, "This is madness. What a time to be alive."( Jenner responded with a video on Instagram of her cracking an egg open with the caption: "Take that little egg."( Platanov was surprised by his photo's popularity, writing, "Egg is just an egg."(

On December 18, 2022, footballerLionel Messi posted a carousel with photos of him lifting the FIFA World Cup Trophy and celebrating with his teammates after winning the 2022 FIFA World Cup with Argentina, which reached 10 million likes within the first 39 minutes of its sharing.( The following day, the post became the most-liked Instagram post in the first 24 hours of its sharing, with 50 million likes.( On December 20, 2022, the post reached over 56 million likes, surpassing the previous record held by @world_record_egg.(

Within 48 hours of Messi posting, the Instagram post had surpassed 64 million likes, and in doing so, it became the most-liked social media post ever across all social media platforms, by overtaking the most-liked post on YouTube, the music video for the song "Despacito", which had reached 50.2 million likes, and the most-liked post on TikTok, a video uploaded by Bella Poarch featuring her lip-syncing to the song "Sophie Aspin Send", which had reached 60.3 million likes.( This also meant that it became the first ever post on Instagram to reach 60 and 70 million likes, achieving that in just 3 days since it was posted.(

# What Is the Most Liked Instagram Post of All Time?

Jenna ShishillaJenna ShishillaApril 7, 2025June 23rd, 20269 min read

What Is the Most Liked Instagram Post of All Time?

Last updated on June 23rd, 2026 at 01:41 pm

Instagram isn’t just a photo-sharing app anymore—it’s a cultural barometer. The posts that rack up millions (or tens of millions) of likes often reflect what people care about, laugh at, or feel deeply connected to. But what does it take to earn the title of the most liked Instagram post? You might be surprised by what tops the list—and what doesn’t.

In this post, we’ll break down the five most-liked Instagram posts of all time, as of 2025, explore why each went viral, and help you uncover what brands and creators can learn from them.

## 1. Lionel Messi’s World Cup Victory (75M+ likes)

The most liked Instagram post of all time belongs to Lionel Messi. Shared in December 2022, his post celebrated Argentina’s World Cup victory and featured a carousel of emotional, high-quality images—him holding the trophy, embracing teammates, and smiling with fans. It was more than a sports update; it was a historic and heartfelt moment that fans around the world had waited years to see.What made this post so successful was the timing and emotion behind it. It went live just hours after the final match, while fans were still buzzing with adrenaline. Even those who weren’t die-hard soccer fans were drawn to the human side of the story—persistence, triumph, and legacy. From a marketing perspective, the takeaway is simple: Emotional milestones connect. Whether you’re launching a product or celebrating a business win, capturing the moment authentically and posting at the right time can dramatically boost your reach and engagement.

  Lionel Messi’s World Cup Victory  

## 2. The Instagram Egg (55M+ likes)

Sometimes, the internet just wants to have fun. That’s exactly what happened in 2019 when a stock photo of a plain brown egg—yes, an egg—became a global sensation. Posted by the @world\_record\_egg account, the image set out with one simple goal: to beat Kylie Jenner’s most liked post. No filters, no fame, no brand partnerships. Just an egg and a challenge.

And it worked. In a matter of days, the egg became the most liked Instagram post on the platform. Why? Because it was unexpected, funny, and strangely satisfying. People joined in for the joke, the mission, and the sense of community. Later, the account used its popularity to promote mental health awareness, giving the whole stunt even more meaning. For brands, this shows the power of simplicity and community engagement. You don’t always need polish or celebrity status—sometimes you just need an idea that brings people together.

  The Instagram Egg  

## 3. Billie Eilish Goes Blonde (29M+ likes)

In 2021, Billie Eilish surprised her fans by revealing a brand-new look: platinum blonde hair. The transformation was drastic, especially for someone known for her neon green roots and edgy style. The photo itself was a polished studio shot, but what made it viral was the element of surprise and the symbolic message behind it.

For fans, this post marked the start of a new chapter in Billie’s music and identity. It instantly sparked conversations about reinvention, confidence, and personal growth. From a brand perspective, this is a great reminder that your audience wants to be part of your evolution. Whether it’s a rebrand, product launch, or new direction, visual change paired with authenticity can capture attention and build excitement. It doesn’t need to be loud—just intentional and bold.

  Billie Eilish Goes Blonde  

## 4. Zendaya’s Birthday Post by Tom Holland (28M+ likes)

Tom Holland’s birthday tribute to Zendaya quickly earned a spot among the most liked Instagram posts because of its simplicity, warmth, and relatability. The photo was a behind-the-scenes moment—Tom and Zendaya together on a film set—and the caption was short and sweet. No overthinking. Just a genuine message to someone he cares about.Fans loved the authenticity. It didn’t feel curated or promotional—it felt personal. That’s exactly why it worked. Brands often feel the need to polish every post, but the truth is that relatable, human moments can perform just as well—if not better. Whether it’s celebrating a team member, sharing a client win, or spotlighting a meaningful partnership, showing a softer, more human side of your business builds trust and loyalty.

  Zendaya’s Birthday Post by Tom Holland  

## 5. Chadwick Boseman’s Family Announces His Passing (21M+ likes)

In 2020, the world was stunned by the announcement of Chadwick Boseman’s passing after a private battle with cancer. The post, written by his family, contained no photo—just a black-and-white text message sharing the news, honoring his strength, and highlighting the legacy he left behind. It was raw, quiet, and deeply moving.

This post became one of the most liked Instagram posts of all time because it reflected a shared moment of global grief and respect. It didn’t rely on visuals or hashtags—it connected through truth. For marketers, this is a powerful reminder that social media isn’t just about promotion. It’s a platform for storytelling, reflection, and human connection. There are times to sell, and there are times to pause, honor, and support your community.

  Chadwick Boseman’s Family Announces His Passing  

## Common Threads Between These Posts

What do these very different posts have in common? They all hit emotional, visual, and cultural chords. Each post resonated with people in a real way—whether through joy, loss, humor, or surprise. They were timely, visually impactful (or purposefully simple), and deeply human.

Here are a few consistent themes that stand out across the most liked Instagram posts:

 Emotional connection: Whether it was celebrating a victory, mourning a loss, or sharing love and gratitude, each post made people feel something. Emotion drives interaction—and when people feel, they engage.
 Timing that matched the moment: Posts that were shared during major cultural or emotional moments saw massive engagement. From a World Cup final to a personal transformation, hitting “post” at the right time matters more than most people think.
 Visual simplicity or impact: The egg was a plain photo. Billie’s hair transformation was bold but clean. Tom and Zendaya’s image was casual and real. These posts weren’t cluttered. They focused on a single, strong visual message.
 Relatability or authenticity: Each post felt real. Even when it involved a celebrity, the content didn’t feel forced or overly produced. It felt personal—and that’s what makes people stop scrolling.
 Cultural relevance: These moments didn’t just exist in a vacuum. They were tied to trends, emotions, or shared experiences that people were already talking about. Relevance helps content move faster and farther.

results.title: 20 Most Liked Instagram Posts of All Time
results.content:
Spoiler alert: Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo dominate the list with 12 out of the top 20 most-liked posts.

Let's dive in.

## 20. Ronaldo honors Pelè

Cristiano Ronaldo opens this list with a tribute to Pelé, one of football's greatest players, following his death in 2022. By writing the caption in Portuguese, Ronaldo connected with audiences across Brazil and his native Portugal. The post has earned 31.3 million likes to date.

## 19. Baby in a towel

Sometimes a simple post surprisingly goes viral – a new entry on the list in 2025 is a short but memorable Reel of a smiling baby appearing out of a towel swaddle. Posted on June 10, 2024, the Reel has captured over 31.3 million likes so far.

## 18. Ronaldo and his partner announce twins

Next up is Ronaldo with a post from 2021 announcing that he and his partner Georgina Rodríguez were expecting twins. Tragically, one of the twins passed away during childbirth. The post is filled with comments of love and support.

## 17. Messi and Ronaldo face off in a game of chess

Lionel Messi rivals Ronaldo when it comes to Instagram dominance. So when luxury brand Louis Vuitton brought the two football legends together for an advertising campaign, the internet went wild. The post, shared on Messi's account, has earned over 32 million likes – proof that seeing two of the sport's greatest players in one frame is pure social media gold.

## 16. Sunset on fire

One of the newer entries on our list, this incredible video of a sunset quickly catapulted to the top ten. It’s also the most liked Reel on the list.
